description: List the products Printful has imported from an integrated store (Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce…), with how many variants are synced. Filter by status=unsynced to find products that still need a design or catalog variant. Printful: GET /sync/products.

store_id.description: Store id (numeric) for an ACCOUNT-level token; overrides PRINTFUL_STORE_ID. Not needed with a store-level token.

name: printful_list_sync_products
title: List synced products (integrated store)
